# Neon Escape

Control a neon spaceship navigating through falling asteroids on an HTML canvas. Move left/right to dodge. The game ends when you collide with an asteroid. Score is based on survival time.

<content>
1: // Simple Neon Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Load sound effects (simple beep using data URI)
8:   const crashSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEARKwAABAwAgAEABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='); // placeholder beep
9:   const bgMusic = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEARKwAABAwAgAEABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
10:   bgMusic.loop = true;
11:   bgMusic.volume = 0.2;
12:   bgMusic.play();
13:   const w = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 400);
14:   const h = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600);
15: 
16:   const ship = { x: w / 2, y: h - 40, w: 30, h: 30, vx: 0, speed: 4 };
17:   const stars = [];
18:   const STAR_COUNT = 80;
19:   for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
20:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * w, y: Math.random() * h, size: Math.random() * 2 + 1, opacity: Math.random() });
21:   }
22:   const asteroids = [];
23:   let lastSpawn = 0;
24:   let startTime = performance.now();
25:   let gameOver = false;
26: 
27:   const keys = {};
28:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
29:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
30: 
31:   function spawnAsteroid() {
32:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
33:     asteroids.push({ x: Math.random() * (w - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, vy: Math.random() * 2 + 2 });
34:   }
35: 
36:   function update(dt) {
37:     if (gameOver) return;
38:     // ship movement
39:     ship.vx = 0;
40:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.vx = -ship.speed;
41:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.vx = ship.speed;
42:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(w - ship.w, ship.x + ship.vx));
43: 
44:     // move background stars
45:     for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
46:       const s = stars[i];
47:       s.y += 0.5; // speed of starfield
48:       if (s.y > h) {
49:         s.y = 0;
50:         s.x = Math.random() * w;
51:       }
52:     }
53: 
54:     // spawn asteroids every ~1s
55:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > 1000) {
56:       spawnAsteroid();
57:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
58:     }
59: 
60:     // update asteroids
61:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
62:       const a = asteroids[i];
63:       a.y += a.vy;
64:       if (a.y > h) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
65:       // collision
66:         if (
67:           ship.x < a.x + a.w &&
68:           ship.x + ship.w > a.x &&
69:           ship.y < a.y + a.h &&
70:           ship.y + ship.h > a.y
71:         ) {
72:           crashSound.currentTime = 0;
73:           crashSound.play();
74:           gameOver = true;
75:         }
76:     }
77:   }
78: 
79:   function draw() {
80:     // clear with gradient background
81:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
82:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
83:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#002');
84:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
85:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
86:     // neon style (glow)
87:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#0ff';
88:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
89:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
90:     ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
91:     // ship (neon triangle)
92:     ctx.beginPath();
93:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
94:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
95:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
96:     ctx.closePath();
97:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
98:     ctx.fill();
99:     ctx.stroke();
100:     // stars background (twinkling)
101:     stars.forEach(s => {
102:       ctx.beginPath();
103:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
104:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,255,255,${s.opacity})`;
105:       ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
106:       ctx.shadowBlur = 5;
107:       ctx.fill();
108:     });
109:     // asteroids (glowing circles)
110:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
111:       const cx = a.x + a.w / 2;
112:       const cy = a.y + a.h / 2;
113:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, a.w / 2);
114:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
115:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#001');
116:       ctx.beginPath();
117:       ctx.arc(cx, cy, a.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
118:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
119:       ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
120:       ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
121:       ctx.fill();
122:     });
123:     // score
124:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
125:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
126:     const score = Math.floor((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000);
127:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
128:     if (gameOver) {
129:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
130:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
131:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', w / 2 - 60, h / 2);
132:     }
133:   }
134: 
135:   let last = performance.now();
136:   function loop() {
137:     const now = performance.now();
138:     const dt = now - last;
139:     last = now;
140:     update(dt);
141:     draw();
142:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
143:   }
144:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
145: })();

(End of file - total 145 lines)
</content>
